text:
devon: Heads up — trying to raise GPU quota for prod-dedicated in europe-west3 and GCP is blocking us with an account verification/payment hold. The quota form errors out saying billing verification required.

kai: Ugh, that's the worst timing. Do you have the exact error text or support case? We can escalate.

devon: Error shown in console: 
```
Quota request failed: BILLING_ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED (status=402)
Action required: Verify business identity and payment method before quota increases.
```
Opened support case 2009876543 — link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/2009876543 (sent to account owner).

cloud-support-bot: Case 2009876543 created and assigned to Billing Specialist. Expedited review requested by user. ETA: 48-72 hours.

anya: I can resubmit missing tax docs today. Do we have the DUNS and VAT number on file? Also which billing account is this under (corporate card vs invoicing)?

devon: It's under billing-account: redwood-prod-3 (corporate invoicing). DUNS we have (078901234). VAT: EU-REG-44321. I attached the console screenshot in the case.

kai: Two paths: 1) Wait for GCP verification (2-3 days), or 2) use partner marketplace/reseller to provision a temporary pool — might be cheaper to accept short-term markup but buys time. If we go reseller, we need PO and sign-off from finance.

rachel: We could also launch smaller GPUs in us-east1 where we already have verified quota and use them as a fallback for critical jobs, but beware of cross-region data egress and latency for inference traffic. Not ideal for EU-only workloads.

anya: I can approve a one-off reseller purchase if Marta (CFO) signs off. @luis can legal confirm any data residency/paperwork implications for an EU->US fallback?

luis: Legal: fallback to us-east1 is ok for short-term infra tests but not for production serving EU customer data. If any customer data crosses borders we need a DPIA note and update the data map. For marketplace/reseller, we need the reseller contract + data processing addendum in place. I can review — send docs to legal@redwood.com.

devon: Understood. For immediate work: can we at least get the quota for non-prod in europe-west3? GCP is also denying non-prod increases until account verified. That's killing our rollout schedule.

kai: I'll ping our GCP account rep (via private channel) to escalate. Also trying the support chat now. If we can get a temporary exception for quotas for named projects (non-prod/test), that may be granted faster once account team verifies business entity.

cloud-support-bot: Support update: Case 2009876543 — billing team requested copy of Certificate of Incorporation, recent bank statement, and completed tax form. User uploaded docs at 2026-03-18T10:04Z. Status: Under review.

anya: I uploaded the signed W-8 / EU VAT docs and re-checked company legal name. I can also put the corporate card on file temporarily if that helps speed verification — need procurement approval though.

rachel: If procurement can put a card on file we can at least spin up a small dedicated pool in eu-west3 (T4x) as a stopgap. But that will show higher cost on the card. We should estimate monthly burn before approving.

devon: Estimate for minimal fallback pool (3x T4x for smoke+staging): ~$9k/month. If we use preemptible it could be ~40% cheaper but less reliable.

kai: If the GCP rep can't unblock within 24h, I'll route to our reseller partner to provision a temporary EU pool and loop finance. That requires a PO and reseller contact — @anya can you confirm PO workflow?

anya: PO workflow: submit request in Coupa (code INFRA-EMERG), attach vendor invoice, get CFO sign-off. I can fast-track within 24h if legal clears reseller contract.

luis: I'll prioritize review of the reseller contract. Send contract to me and I'll aim for same-day.

devon: Thanks all. I'll keep the case updated and post any response from GCP here. Current blocker: quota form blocked + payment verification required. Priority: unblock non-prod quotas in eu-west3, if not possible, temporary reseller or us-east1 fallback. :pray:

cloud-support-bot: Case update received at 2026-03-18T14:42Z: Billing team requested final confirmation from Account Owner email. Action required by user: confirm account owner via console or respond to billing-specialist@gcp-support.com.

devon: I forwarded the billing-specialist email to @anya and @marta. @anya can you reply from finance?

anya: Reply sent at 2026-03-18T14:55Z with confirmation and attached incorporation docs. Also flagged for urgent review. :thumbsup:

kai: I'll follow up with the rep now. If anyone hears back directly from GCP please drop the update here.

rachel: FYI — I've queued low-priority batch jobs to run on our existing us-east1 quota to reduce immediate pressure on europe quotas. Not touching customer-facing endpoints.

devon: Update 1hr later: GCP billing team replied asking for proof of tax ID + a contact phone. I've added our finance phone number to the contact. Fingers crossed.

cloud-support-bot: Final notification: Case 2009876543 closed by Billing Specialist (2026-03-19T09:12Z) — account verification completed. Quota forms should now accept requests. If you still see errors, re-open case.

devon: Resolved — verified and submitted non-prod quota increase request; pending approval but form accepted now. Will file follow-up if prod quota still blocked. Thanks all for quick cycle. :tada:
